title: MintAssemblyAIToken
description: supabase/functions/mint-assemblyai-token/index.ts. Mints a short-lived (120s) AssemblyAI v3 streaming token, used as a ?token= query param on the wss://streaming.assemblyai.com/v3/ws connection so the raw AssemblyAI key never reaches the client WebSocket. Requires a verified Supabase JWT only (no voice-quota check in this function today — contrast with mint-realtime-token, which does check checkVoiceQuota; this appears to be an asymmetry in the current source, not something this audit should paper over).

token.description: Empty string if AssemblyAI's response omitted it.

error.description: Either a string code (unauthenticated, ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY secret not set) or the raw AssemblyAI error payload forwarded via json({error: payload}, res.status) on an upstream failure.
